title: arm parameter threads through claim/logs but not the in-tx MalformedMetadata reason strings — async settle failures get mislabeled 'checkout.session.completed' reasons
detail: run_completed_side_effects is reached from both arms, but its three MalformedMetadata reasons hardcode 'checkout.session.completed'. An async_payment_succeeded event failing metadata validation logs '(<arm>) rolled back: checkout.session.completed invalid vacancy_id…' — contradictory labels in a payment incident.
recommended_fix: Thread arm into run_completed_side_effects and interpolate it into the three MalformedMetadata reason strings (or hoist a single event-type label), so settle-arm rollbacks report the real event type.
